title: Cech cup products and pullback
statement: Let f:X' \to X be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let U be an arbitrary open cover of X, and let U' be an open cover of X' together with a specified refinement map U' \to f^{-1}U in the sense of Stacks Tag 01FD. Let F and G be quasi-coherent modules on X [pqf-def-coherent], and write f^*F and f^*G for their pullbacks to X' [def-pc-module-pullback]. (a) The refinement cochain map from the Cech complex of (X,U,F) to that of (X',U',f^*F) induces the usual pullback map H^p(X,F) \to H^p(X',f^*F) under the Cech comparison maps whenever the comparison maps exist. (b) For arbitrary covers, the signed Cech cup-product cochain map induces the sheaf cup product H^p(X,F) \otimes H^q(X,G) \to H^{p+q}(X,F\otimes G), as in Tag 07MB. Both assertions are natural in F,G and f.
